factories.name: newSendRequestStep
factories.description: Send one HTTP request to the connection's API with the OAuth access token as a Bearer credential, and return the status code and body. Refreshes the token first when it is about to expire and once more after a 401. Every unknown outcome, such as a lost connection, a timeout, a 5xx, or a status that does not prove a refusal, sends the request again, except that a POST without idempotencyKeyHeader whose answer was lost selects uncertain; use it only for requests that are safe to repeat: reads, absolute updates, deletes, or writes the API deduplicates through idempotencyKeyHeader. Use postNonIdempotent for a POST that must never be sent twice.

inputSchema.description: SendRequestInput describes one HTTP request to the connection's API.

body.description: Body is the request body, sent as text. It is not allowed with GET or HEAD and is limited to the connection's maxBodyBytes. Content-Type defaults to application/json when Headers sets none.

headers.description: Headers holds extra request headers, such as Accept. Authorization, Cookie, Host, and the headers the transport owns select defect; the connector always sends Authorization: Bearer with the access token.

idempotencyKeyHeader.description: IdempotencyKeyHeader names a header, such as Idempotency-Key, that carries the Step's idempotency key, which is the same for every retry of one Step execution. Blank sends none.

method.description: Method is GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE, compared without case. Blank means GET.

path.description: Path is the request path under the connection's apiBaseUrl. It starts with a single slash, may be percent-encoded, and carries no query, fragment, backslash, or .. segment. Set exactly one of Path and URL.

query.description: Query holds query parameters that are added to those already in URL. A name may repeat through several values.

url.description: URL is an absolute http or https URL with the scheme, host, and port of the connection's apiBaseUrl, such as a next-page link the API returned. Set exactly one of Path and URL.

factories.name: newPostNonIdempotentStep
factories.description: Send one HTTP POST that must never be sent twice, such as a payment or an order the API does not deduplicate, with the OAuth access token as a Bearer credential, and return the status code and body. It is sent at most once per Step execution: when the POST may have reached the API but no usable answer arrived, the Step selects uncertain instead of sending it again. A 401 renews the token and a 429 or 503 waits, then sends again, because those answers prove the API did not process it.

inputSchema.description: PostNonIdempotentInput describes one HTTP POST that must never be sent twice.

body.description: Body is the request body, sent as text and limited to the connection's maxBodyBytes. Content-Type defaults to application/json when Headers sets none. Blank sends an empty body.

headers.description: Headers holds extra request headers, such as Accept. Authorization, Cookie, Host, and the headers the transport owns select defect; the connector always sends Authorization: Bearer with the access token.

path.description: Path is the request path under the connection's apiBaseUrl. It starts with a single slash, may be percent-encoded, and carries no query, fragment, backslash, or .. segment. Set exactly one of Path and URL.

query.description: Query holds query parameters that are added to those already in URL. A name may repeat through several values.

url.description: URL is an absolute http or https URL with the scheme, host, and port of the connection's apiBaseUrl. Set exactly one of Path and URL.
